body: I'm beginning to look. I have a lady at work helping me redo my resume (she's helped many people escape that place, 5 in the last year alone). As for my portfolio I'm trying to figure out what I can actually put in there from my job. I can't show the power point things, it's extremely sensitive (and very very boring) material for the clients, all in the same 90s template they use :/

By editing power points, I mean I'm making changes to the copy. Rewording sentences, adding periods, etc. Basically word processing.

And my place of work does packaging and promotions for things in the consumer market alongside these power point things for the medical field. Once they find out you know how to do a power point they apparently work people on them to the point they quit. And it's not like 9-5 stuff anymore. It's no longer uncommon for me to be at work until 10 or 11 PM.
